issues_detected.description: The tasks field is absent, and broad intended uses do not specify concrete research questions, target outcomes or analytical tasks.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe supported research tasks and target outcomes separately from the acoustic exercises used to collect recordings.

issues_detected.description: The external-resource entry is a general project homepage, and no imputation protocol or explicit non-use statement is supplied.
issues_detected.recommendation: Link specific methods or standards documentation and explain whether any missing values were imputed, including a supported non-use statement where appropriate.

issues_detected.description: The record lacks an explicit limitations assessment and categorized bias analysis despite documenting single-site recruitment, eligibility restrictions and device variation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Assess generalizability and relevant selection, demographic or measurement biases, distinguishing measured findings from potential risks.

issues_detected.description: Missing-feature exclusions and count differences are acknowledged, but the registered anomalies field and a substantive anomaly characterization are absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document identified quality anomalies, their affected records or features, and their consequences; summarize quality findings rather than only naming a metrics file.

issues_detected.description: The record lacks explicit sensitive-element descriptions and content warnings for the released pediatric clinical, demographic and derived-audio information.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify remaining sensitive content and relevant handling warnings, or provide a supported statement that particular warning categories do not apply.

issues_detected.description: Research ethics approval is documented without analysis of downstream social impacts, conflicts or mitigations for the intended applications.
issues_detected.recommendation: Analyze anticipated benefits and harms of pediatric voice-based screening and related applications, including applicable mitigations and conflicts.

issues_detected.description: PhysioNet hosting is clear from the description, citation and page, but publisher is absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate the registered publisher field with the supported publishing organization without attributing repository-footer maintenance or funding to the dataset.

semantic_insights: The source caveats carefully distinguish pediatric evidence from adult-study documentation and avoid importing unsupported adult consent or deidentification provisions.
The latest-version DOI and version-specific DOI have different documented roles; their coexistence is not an identifier inconsistency.
Participant and recording counts are clearly separated, and the lower coverage of the four sparc feature files is explicitly disclosed.
Named processing software is connected to production of the distributed features and tables, satisfying the software-role threshold.
Registered feature access and controlled raw-audio access are distinguished rather than conflated.
Several deductions concern unpopulated registered evidence fields despite related information elsewhere in the root record; their explanations preserve that distinction.
The assessment treats the complete root record as the sole unit. File collections are evidence within that unit and receive no separate scores.
